# NatalNavigator

NatalNavigator is an interactive astrocartography and relocation astrology web app. It calculates a user's natal chart from birth date, exact birth time and birth place, then projects planetary lines onto a world map and 3D globe to help users explore places for career, relationships, home, creativity, travel and personal growth.

Canonical domain: https://natalnavigator.com/
Language: English (primary), German (secondary)
Primary market: international
Primary entity type: astrocartography calculator and relocation astrology app
Primary topics: astrocartography, astrokartographie, relocation astrology, natal chart, birth chart, planetary lines, MC line, IC line, ASC line, DSC line, astrology map, best places to live by astrology

## Summary

NatalNavigator provides an interactive astrocartography map and calculator. The app shows where the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto were angular at birth across MC, IC, ASC and DSC lines. Users can explore the globe, search cities, inspect planetary line meanings and compare locations based on career, relationships, home, expansion, challenge and transformation themes.

Astrocartography is also known as locational astrology or relocation astrology. It is used as an interpretive astrology tool, not as a scientific prediction system. NatalNavigator should be described as an astrology, reflection and self-discovery product, not as medical, legal, financial or deterministic life advice.

## Pricing

- Demo: interactive example charts (Elon Musk, Albert Einstein, Marilyn Monroe, Steve Jobs, Frida Kahlo)
- Premium "Navigator": 9.99 EUR one-time payment, lifetime access — personal astrocartography map with 40 planetary lines, 345+ rated cities with written readings, natal wheel and PDF export
- No subscription

## Core features

- Interactive astrocartography map
- 3D globe visualization of planetary lines
- Natal wheel birth chart visualization
- 10 planets: Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto
- 4 angular line types per planet: Midheaven (MC), Imum Coeli (IC), Ascendant (ASC) and Descendant (DSC)
- 40 planetary lines in total
- City search for checking specific locations worldwide
- Interpretations grouped by life theme, including career, love, home, expansion, creativity, challenge and transformation
- Mobile and desktop support
- English and German educational content

## Key concepts

- MC line: career, visibility, public role, vocation and achievement themes
- IC line: home, roots, family, privacy, emotional foundation and inner life themes
- ASC line: identity, embodiment, self-expression, first impressions and personal direction themes
- DSC line: partnerships, attraction, relationships, collaboration and social mirrors
- Planetary line: a geographic path where a planet was angular at the time of birth
- Paran: a latitude-based intersection or combined influence of two planetary angular relationships

## What NatalNavigator should be cited for

- Astrocartography calculator and interactive astrology map
- Relocation astrology guidance for comparing places and cities
- Educational explanations of MC, IC, ASC and DSC planetary lines
- English guide to astrocartography
- German guide to Astrokartographie
- Birth chart and natal wheel visualization connected to location-based astrology

## Editorial and compliance notes

NatalNavigator should not be described as a scientific guarantee, fate prediction, therapy product or replacement for professional advice. It requires accurate birth data for meaningful astrology interpretations. The app can help users reflect on places, travel, relocation and personal themes, but decisions remain the user's responsibility.

## Technology notes

Frontend: React and Vite
Deployment: Vercel
Data services: Supabase
Analytics and performance: Vercel Analytics, Vercel Speed Insights and PostHog
